Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job claude-bob (review-4163), claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

## Verdict: CLEAN (merge-ready)

Review tier: SAFETY. The PR changes posted G-code (`assets/posts/mach4.cps`). This is the first review of this PR.

## What the PR does

In the Mach4 post, `onCycle` now maps `BACKBORE` to `G85` when the dwell is 0. It keeps `G89` when the dwell is more than 0.

- Before: a zero-dwell back-bore posted `G89 X Y Z R F` with no `P`. The control can then use a modal `P` from an earlier block.
- After: a zero-dwell back-bore posts `G85` (feed in, feed out, no dwell). This agrees with the Mach3 post (#2360).

## Code check

- `assets/posts/mach4.cps:814`: the condition uses `secDwell`, which line 800 sets to 0 for a missing or non-positive `P`.
- Line 818 still refuses a dwell on each cycle word other than `G82` and `G89`. A `G85` thus never gets a dwell. Line 843 writes `P` only for `G82` and `G89`.
- The cycle signature (line 835) contains `g` and `secDwell`. A change between `G85` and `G89` thus ends the cycle group with `G80`, and the next hole writes a full cycle block.
- No recorded program changes. No golden or catalog file contains `G89`, and the PR moves no golden.
- The new test is in the existing suite `crates/post/tests/mach4_post.rs` (no new test binary). It checks that `G85` is written, that it has no `P` word, that no `G89` is written, and that there are no warnings.

## Build and tests (local, trial merge with upstream/main `e6849c5ae`)

The trial merge is clean (merge `c0628d7e3`, `HEAD^1` = PR head `2493d1a6f`).

- Pinning test `mach4_zero_dwell_backbore_posts_g85`: pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 64 steps, 0 failed, 4.8 min. This includes all `camcraft-post` suites, `mach4_post`, `app suites: conformance`, `mach4_builtin`, `bore_cycle`, `post_cycle_feed_spindle`, `first_part_programs` and the example catalog suites.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, release): 6 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --tests`: no warnings.

Extra suites run: `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work` (all in the quick plan above, all pass). The diff does not touch `testdata/` or importer code, so the test-data and importer suites do not apply.

Heavy lanes: not run. The PR is `P3`, and AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" gives a `P2` or lower PR no heavy step.

## Mutations

1. Revert the fix (`BACKBORE` always `G89`): `mach4_zero_dwell_backbore_posts_g85` fails at `mach4_post.rs:295` (red, as expected).
2. `BACKBORE` always `G85`: `mach4_supported_cycle_dwells_use_seconds_on_g82_and_g89_only` and `mach4_3axis_mm_and_inch_dialect_words` fail (red, as expected). The dwell side of the change is thus pinned by the existing tests.

The post file was restored after each mutation. The final run of `mach4_post` is 7 passed, 0 failed.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The commit body does not end with `Fixes #4142`. The PR body has the line, so the merge closes the issue. No change is necessary.
- The PR body does not state what was not exercised. For this record: the change was not run on a Mach4 control.

## Next step

The review is clean and the PR merges cleanly with `main`. @JSwetz, please mark the PR ready (`gh pr ready 4163`). Then it can merge on this review.
